tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ku ru kul+le'i rjes gnang bya tshul rig byed lam bzang nyi 'od bzhugs so// na mo gu ru rat+na war+dhā ye/ rig byed ma'i rjes gnang bya ba'i tshul ni/ gzhi dmar po'i steng du tsan+dan dmar pos byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal la me tog dmar po'i tshom bu bkod/ bris sku yod na dgram/ chu bzhi sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang smug rtsis byugs pa'i gtor ma gcig slob dpon gyis mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu me tog rnams bshams/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung / mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba/ yul nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du rgyun mi chad par gyur/ zhes dang so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ nī ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ni wi te hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ khaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' gnyis 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar te/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke/ ghan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta'i bar dang / mthar rdo rje snying khar bzung dril bu rgyun dkrol/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe ṭa/ pra tsa li te/ pra dz+nyā pa ra mi ta nā da swa bhā we/ badz+ra dharmā hrīḥd ya ni/

san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod de gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis kyang byin gyis brlab par bsam mo/ /mchod pa rnams kyi phyag rgya ni/ khu tshur kha sbyar gung mo gnyis/ /brkyangs te rtse sbyar chu bzhi'i rgya/ /khu tshur gyen 'thor me tog gis/ /mgul du blug pa bdug pa'i lo/ /mthe bong gyen bsgrengs mar me'i ste/ /thal mo phyir bstan dri mchog gis/ /de ni gyen bkan zhal zas so/ /se gol gtogs pa rol mo'i sgra/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /skyabs yul mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge'i khri pad nyi la bla ma 'od dpag med longs spyod rdzogs sku dmar po mnyam bzhag can gyi sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs bla ma dang sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa la/ bdag dang sems can rnams 'jigs dad snying rje gsum gyi sgo nas byang chub bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bsam pas ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la༞ dam pa'i chos rnams la༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞ zhes ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/

de'i ched du rje btsun rig byed lha mo'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed byas la/ rang skad cig gis ku ru kul+ler gsal ba'i thugs kar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dbu la bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥku ru kul+le bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ ku ru kul+le zhes sogs sngon 'gro'i/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ thal mo sbyar la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces lan gcig brjod/ oṃ shu n+yā ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes sngags brjod pas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig dmar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu 'phros pas 'phags pa rnams mchod/

sems can thams cad rje btsun ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥyig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis kyis ut+pa la'i mda' gzhu rna ba'i drung du 'gengs shing / g.yas 'og mas khams gsum 'gugs par byed pa'i lcags kyu dang / g.yon 'og mas ut+pa la'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs shing 'dzum khro'i rnam pa can spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ nu 'bur zung gis mdzes shing lang tsho lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu dbu skra khams pa gyen du brdzes pa/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan zhing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yon du bstan pa'i steng du zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i brla la g.yas pa'i brang ba bshad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu'i 'od kor gyis yongs su mdzes shing snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i skur gyur/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i ut+pa la dmar po'i lte bar nyi ma la hrīḥdamar pos mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rig byed kyi phug nas rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le la sangs rgyas byang sems bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ la sogs pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣīn+tsa hūm̐/

zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan par bsam/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis mchod par bsam zhing thal mo sbyar la/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing / /suk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdungs/ /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen pos rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces pas mchod/ yi ge sngags rnams rnam par spangs/ /sgra dang thig le sems kyang med/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /bdag med gzhan yang med pa nyid/ /ces pas bstod/ bdud rtsi snod dang bcas pa/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ swa bhā wā zhes pas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu bdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du shar du go las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha/ sha de rnams re re'i steng du yang / bdud rtsi lnga lnga yod pa ni/ shar du bh+rūm̐ las dri chen/ lhor āṃ las rak+ta/ nub tu dz+rīṃ las byang sems/ byang du khaṃ las sha chen gyi dwangs la/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chu/ de rnams kyi steng du shar du bh+rūm̐ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor āṃ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+rīṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/

dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ zla ba'i mthar g.yon skor gyis/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ri rī/ li lī/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ g.yas skor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bltas pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pa rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung g.yos me sbar bas/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing skol bas rlangs pa gyen la song bas oṃ dang rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon te rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ zhes dang / lag pa g.yon g.yas gnyis ka dang / gdan bzhi las/ lag pa gnyis ni bkan byas la/ /srin lag gnyis ni phan tshun dkri/ /gung mo dang ni mtheb rtse sbyar/ /khro bo gnyis ni mnan par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ aḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blangs te myong / bde bas mnyes par bsam/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor ba/ mar me'i phreng ba lta bu las 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi stobs sogs kyi yon tan thams cad dang /

skye 'gro bsod nams can rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang dbang thang thams cad 'od zer kha dog dmar po'i rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim/ par bsam la/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswāhā/ zhes ma yengs par tsan+dan dmar po'i phreng ba ming med kyi steng nas drangs shing bgrang la phreng 'khor gcig sogs kyi mthar/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus par stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ man ngag thob na rang byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa bsgom pa ni/ lus gnad bcos te rlung ro bsal la/ rang nyid rje btsun ma ku ru kul+ler gsal ba'i lus kyi nang phru ma phus btab pa dmar seng nge ba'i dbus lte ba nas spyi bo'i bar la rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar ser/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar po me'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar smug g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po chu'i rang bzhin kha dog dkar po ste gsum ka gro sogs 'bring po tsam dbu ma la brten pa'i lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte ba dbu ma'i mas snar oṃ dmar po dbu can gyi shad lta bu'i klad kor dbu ma'i nang du chud pa me'i rang bzhin kha dog dmar ser mgo gyen du bstan pa/ nang 'khor 'dab ma brgyad la mdun nas brtsams te/ a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha/ phyi skor drug cu rtsa bzhi la mdun nas g.yon bskor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ rnams mgo gyen du bstan pa/ mdun nas brtsams te/ g.yas bskor du/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ rnams mgo gyen du bstan pa/ phyi nang gi yig 'bru thams cad kha dog dmar ser/ snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su hūm̐/ phyogs bzhir bh+rūm̐/ ām̐/ dz+rīṃ/ khaṃ/ mtshams bzhir/

laṃ/ maṃ/ paṃ/ taṃ/ rnams kha dog sngon po mgo thur du bstan pa/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bcu drug pa'i dbus su aṃ/ rtsa 'dab bcu drug la mdun du g.yon bskor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ā+ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ rnams kha dog dmar po mgo gyen du bstan pa/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dbus dbu ma'i yas snar haṃ dkar po mgo thur bstan/ klad kor dbu ma'i nang du chud pa 'dab ma sum cu so gnyis la mdun nas g.yon skor du/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ g.yas skor du/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta rnams kha dog dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gis steng dbu ma'i nang du hrīḥdamar po mgo gyen bstan pa/ bshang sgor rlung / sum mdor me/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gyi sbyor ba lan gsum byas mtha' ma la bsdams pas bshang sgo'i rlung g.yos/ sum mdo'i me sbar te lte ba'i aṃ la bsnun pas aṃ las me shin tu cha phra ba g.yas ro ma nas song / lte ba'i rtsa 'khor gyi/ yig 'bru rnams kyi khams snyigs bsregs/ yang ro ma nas song / snying kha'i yig 'bru rnams kyi khams snyigs bsregs/ hrīḥlas 'od dmar po 'phros pas/ g.yas kyi me dang lhan cig tu ro ma nas song / mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab kyi khams snyigs bsregs/ me ro ma'i yas sna nas thon/ thod pa'i nang du mdun nas g.yon bskor gyi rna ba g.yas pa'i bu ga nas song / phyag g.yas pa'i mda' stong sbyar ba'i mda'i stong nas zhugs/ rim pas song ste/ mde'u ut+pal dmar po kha bye nas 'od zer phyir song bas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems sems can thams cad ku ru kul+ler gsal ba'i rna ba g.yas pa nas zhugs/ spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga lte ba rnams kyi 'khor lo'i khams kyi dwangs ma rnams bsdus nas/ rna ba g.yas pa'i bu ga nas 'thon/

rang gi ut+pa la'i mde'u'i nang du zhugs/ rna ba g.yas pa nas song / ltag pa nas g.yas su bskor te/ spyi bo'i haṃ zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems dang 'grogs nas g.yon rkyang ma nas thur du babs pas mgrin pa dang / snying ga'i 'khor lor rgyas par byas/ lte ba'i aṃ la thigs pa gcig phog pas me cher 'bar/ dbu ma'i mas sna kha bye nas/ dbu ma nas yar song / snying ga'i hūm̐ dang hrīḥmagrin pa'i aṃ rnams kyi snyigs ma bsregs/ dbu ma'i mas sna kha bye ste/ spyi bo'i haṃ la phog pas/ haṃ las byang sems dkar po babs pas/ mgrin pa dang snying ga'i yi ge gsum gsos btab/ lte ba'i gang sor bzhi tsam du 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad pas 'khor 'das thams cad dbang du 'dus/ zhes brjod cing gsal btab la rlung bum ba can ci thub gzung / mi thub na rlung dal bus btang zhing ngal gsos/ rlung bzung ba'i tshe 'bar 'dzag la yid drag tu gtad cing / mthar byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsis gsang gnas yan chad du khyab cing gang ba la brten nas byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang bzhi thob cing / yas babs kyi dga' ba bzhi'i rtogs pa skyes te/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dri ma med pa las byung ba'i dam pa'i bde ba bla na med pas rang gi lus dang snod bcud thams cad khyab par mos te/ gang la thog ma dbus mtha' med/ /srid med mya ngan 'das pa med/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /bdag med gzhan yang yod ma yin/ /rang gi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum thams cad kyis stong pa'i de bzhin nyid dang / 'khor 'das gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba'i mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par snang tsam dbyer mi phyed pa'i bde stong dbyer med nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /zhes brjod cing gsal btab la shis pa khong lhod kyis klod nas mnyam par bzhag ldang bar 'dod na/

rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pa'i gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim/ zhes brjod 'dir rje btsun ma'i sku bsgom zhing sngags bzlas pa ni bum dbang gi lam/ rtsa gsum dang 'khor lo bzhi gsal btab nas 'bar 'dzag la sems gtad pa ni gsang dbang gi lam/ bde ba'i nyams myong la sems gtad pa ni shes rab ye shes kyi lam/ gang la thog ma sogs kyi tshig don la mnyam par 'jog pa ni dbang bzhi pa'i lam yin no/ /tshom bu/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod brgyad kyis zhes pa nas/ yongs su gyur pa las bar/ rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le zhes pa nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim bar/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bar/ 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol bar/ zhes gsol ba btab pas nas/ dbu brgyan bar bdag mdun tshig bsgyur mi 'dra ba de rnams ma gtogs gong bzhin no/ /mchod pa/ a mṛ tas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung / mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ ni rī khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ni wi te hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' gnyis 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar te/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta'i bar/ oṃ ku ru kul+le sa pa ri wā ra/ nī ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/zhabs bsil/ nas shap+ta'i bar la'ang rigs 'gre sbyar/ oṃ ku ru kul+le sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis nang mchod phul/ rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i steng ka dang /

dril bu sh+lau ka rdzogs mtshams gsil/ brtse bas rjes chags pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku/ /mda' gzhu ut+pal dbang gi lcags kyu 'dzin/ /bcom ldan rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs gong gi bdud rtsi byin rlabs bzhin/ rje btsun ma'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ a kā ro btags pas phul/ oṃ ku ru kul+le oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ nai wi d+ya āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs/ brtse bas rjes chags pad+ma rwa ga'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku/ /mda' gzhu ut+pal dbang gi lcags kyu 'dzin/ /bcom ldan rig byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyis sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /thugs rgyud bskul ba'i bzlas pa bya/ dbang gi smin pa'i slob ma nyer lnga man khrus byas/ phyag dang rigs mthun gyi yon phul nas gral la 'khod pa la/ maṇ+ḍal nas bkram bsdu grub pa dang / slob dpon gyis/ 'o sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/

de la 'dir dpal kyai rdo rje'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud rnams nas bshad pa'i rje btsun ma'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ sngon gyi lo rgyus ni/ sngon rgyal po lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pa zhes bya ba rgyal srid che zhing mtho ba gcig la/ 'bangs 'khor g.yog dang btsun mo mang du yod pa las/ btsun mo gnang chen zhes bya ba'i gam du rgyal po 'khor du ma 'dod pa las/ btsun mo des g.yog mo zhig la rgyal po dbang du byed pa'i rig pa tshol cig ces bsgos nas btang bas/ bran mo des tshong 'dus rnams dang / khyad par skud pa 'tshong ba'i tshong 'dus su phyin pas bud med dmar smug shin tu mdzes pa zhig dang 'phrad de/ de la rgyal po dbang du byed pa'i rig pa yod dam zhes dris pas/ de 'dra ba yod srid zer/ der de la gsol ba btab pas gang dmigs pa de la 'di byin cig gsungs nas bza' rgyu'i rigs shig bskur ba btsun mo la gtad/ de lo rgyus bsnyad pas btsun mo'i bsam pa la 'di 'dra ba rgyal po la drang na ma legs pa bzhin 'byung ba srid snyam nas/ pho brang gi nye logs na mtsho zhig yod pa la bskyur bas/ de'i nub mo nas klu'i rgyal po zhig btsun mo'i sar 'ong nas brtse zhing dga' mgur spyad pas btsun mo de srog chags dang ldan par gyur pa na/ rgyal po na re/ bud med de'i rtsar ngas ma phyin pas/ de la chad pas chod cig ces bsgo ba na/ btsun mos sngar gyi lo rgyus bsnyad pas/ rgyal po na re/ re zhig brtag par bya yi zer nas/ sngar gyi bran mo de tshong 'dus su bu mo de 'tshol du btang bas/ rnyed de pho brang du spyan drangs 'ongs pas/ rgyal pos bcom ldan 'das ma yin par shes te rjes su gzung bar zhus pas des rjes su gdams shing byin gyis brlabs nas mchog gi dngos grub thob ste/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon chen po lhan cig skyes pa'i rol pa zhes bya bar gyur ro/

/de lta bu'i slob dpon des 'di'i sgrub thabs mdzad cing / de las rim par brgyud pa'i gdams pa yin no/ /'di ma brjod kyang rung / rjes gnang dngos la slob dpon gyi bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub nas/ slob ma'i bya ba la 'os pa/ slob dpon la rje btsun ma dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lor rnam sbyong ba/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin skyobs/ /khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo mthu chen gyis/ /blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /lan gsum/ zhes gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams steng gi cha la bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza/ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ phyag dang mchod pa phul bar mos pa byas te thal mo sbyar nas 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥku ru kul+le bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya tshogs zhing ltar mchod pa byas nas/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la/ sogs nas/ 'grub par shog ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas tshogs zhing rnams mdun bskyed kyi lha mo la thim par mos pa mdzod/ de rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi lha mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rang gi lus la zhugs pas/

tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs te lus dri ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de la dmigs te slob dpon gyis oṃ shu n+yā ta/ sogs nas/ snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i skur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod pas slob ma lhar bskyed/ de nas slob dpon dang khyed rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig las 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs rig byed kyi phug na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma'i thugs kar phog pas de'i thugs rgyud bskul te thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po'i phreng ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dmar khrig khrig byon te khyed rang gi lus la thim pas lus 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad la phog pas snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang / bcud thams cad rje btsun ma'i skur gyur te slar tshur 'dus nas khyed rang la thim/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs rig byed kyi phug na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma'i sku la phog pas de las de 'dra ba'i rje btsun ma'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te khyed rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ ces dang sngags kyi mthar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes yang yang brjod/ dril bu gsil zhing gu gul gyis bdug des rje btsun ma'i sku'i rjes gnang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lus lhar bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu rje btsun ma'i sku dang rang gi lus dbyer med du byin gyis rlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du khyed rang rnams rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar pad nyi'i steng du hrīḥyig gcig bsams te/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma la gus 'dud drag po dung pa byas pas/ de gnyis ka'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung /

zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hrīḥyig gi mthar g.yas bskor du 'khod par mos pa byas/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum lam nyi shu rtsa lnga mdzod/ oṃ nas/ swāhā/ zhes bzlas pa dang pos rgyud byin gyis rlobs so/ /gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pa man gyis brtan par byas par mos te/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog gtor nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gi sogs lan gsum brjod nas/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byin gyis brlabs te khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs lan gsum gyi mthar/ rdo rje slob ma 'di'i rgyud la rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig des rje btsun ma'i gsung gi rjes gnang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag ngag sngags zlos pa la dbang / 'bras bu rje btsun ma'i gsung dang rang gi ngag dbyer med du byin gyis brlab snyam du mos pa mdzod/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang / stobs dang / mi 'jigs pa dang / ma 'dres pa'i chos la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad hrīḥyig gam 'od zer kha dog dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs te khyed rang gi thugs kar thim pas de rnams kyi byin rlabs thams cad rgyud la zhugs par mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad hrīḥyig gi sogs 'gre/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas tshangs pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa 'jig rten pa'i chen po rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang dbang thang thams cad gong ltar spyan drangs te khyed rang la thim pas tshe dang bsod nams dang dbang thang thams cad rgyas par mos pa mdzod/

slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po dang / paṇ+ḍi ta dang / skye 'gro bsod nams can rnams kyi lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan dang / tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor thams cad kyang gong ltar spyan drangs pas/ khyed rang la thim pas lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i yon tan tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ.a be sha ya hrīḥhrīḥhrīḥ zhes yang yang brjod cing gu gul gyis bdug dril bus sgra res 'jog tu bya/ des rje btsun ma'i thugs kyi rjes gnang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag sems ye shes su bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu rje btsun ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin bstan la ngo sprod pa'am mi sprad kyang rung ngo / /de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le'i rjes gnang zab mo gsan pa yin pas dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs la srung sdom bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ rjes gnang gsan pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas lus longs spyod thams cad cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas sogs lan gsum/ des rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs slob ma rang gnas su btang / rjes mchod pa byin rlabs sogs mdun bskyed skabs bzhin phyi mchod nang mchod bstod pa rnams bya/ bcom ldan 'das mas sogs bzlas pa'i mjug bzhin/ oṃ shrī badz+ra sogs yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang / sogs sh+lau ka gcig oṃ khyed kyis sogs sh+lau ka gcig gi mthar/ badz+ra muḥ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/

dam tshig pa rang la thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rig byed lha mo 'grub gyur nas sogs/ ston mchog dam pa sogs bkra shis ci rigs bya'o// //zhes pa 'di'ang ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi gsung dang rang gi sngar brtsams tshom bar gtong spod skabs kyi 'don khrigs bzhin nag 'gros su sa skya pa kun blos rang gi sring mo kun skyid chos skal bzang mo'i ngor bkod pa'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ kurukul+le'i rjes gnang bya tshul rig byed lam bzang nyi 'od/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
